sentences.en: The money will probably be split evenly between those two.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱可能会平均分给那两个人。

sentences.en: The story was so funny that I split my sides.
sentences.zh: 这个故事太好笑了，我都笑岔气了。

sentences.en: We went together to Laramie, but then we split up.
sentences.zh: 我们一起去拉里米市，但后来我们就分手了。

senses.zh: 劈开的 Split斯普利特(南斯拉夫港市)
